entities.summary: Ulfat Mansurovich Mustafin was a Russian politician, manager and civil servant. He served as mayor of Ufa, capital of the Republic of Bashkortostan, from 2018 until his death in office from COVID-19 during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020.
